name: Fresh signup → onboarding form → agent creation → dashboard
steps: Sign up with a new test email
Fill in agent name, avatar, voice
Verify dashboard loads with the new agent
expected: Full onboarding flow completes: signup → form → agent created → dashboard with greeting

name: Login page loads at /login
steps: Verify login form is visible with email and OAuth options
expected: Login page loads with 'Continue with Email' and OAuth buttons

name: /dashboard/login redirects to /login
steps: Verify redirect to /login with query params preserved
expected: Redirects to /login, any query parameters are preserved

name: Unauthenticated dashboard access redirects to login
steps: Navigate to /dashboard directly without being logged in

name: OnboardingGuard doesn't block returning users
preconditions: Logged in as existing user with completed onboarding
steps: Verify dashboard loads directly without showing onboarding form
expected: Dashboard loads directly, no onboarding form shown for existing users

name: Agent greeting fires after onboarding
steps: Verify agent sends an automatic greeting message in chat
expected: Agent greeting appears automatically in the chat after onboarding completes

name: No dead call modals during onboarding
steps: Watch for any unexpected modals or dialogs appearing
expected: No unexpected modals, call dialogs, or error popups appear during onboarding
